title: When using API Gateway, scaffolder / archetype must not include listener-config
description: The archetype and scaffolder should behave in different ways depending on the runtime that is running for. When using API Gateway, the archetype of apikit and the scaffolded xml generates/uses a listener-config instead of being prepared to use the api-gateway domain (with its own listener-config).   As a consequence, with this current behaviour, if a user does not modify the domain and does not delete the listener-config that is in the xml config, the project will fail when deploying to API Gateway in CloudHub.     Steps to reproduce:  Scenario 1:  - Create a new apikit project   - Upload it to Cloudhub, choosing API Gateway 2.0.x in the runtimes list.    Scenario 2:  - Create a new apikit project   - Modify the raml file, adding some resources.  - Use the scaffolder to generate the flows.  - Upload it to Cloudhub, choosing API Gateway 2.0.x in the runtimes list.    The changes of this isssue involves:  - Scaffolder  - Studio Archetype  - Apikit Archetype
